text: {"reply":"Thanks, Robert. I need to correct my colleague's earlier message. I can't give part prices, delivery times or fitting times, and I can't send quotes by email. A parts advisor will confirm which piece you need (the lower shield may not be the same as the deflector), its availability and price, and whether we can fit it. A person will review this and follow up with you. Which service branch do you prefer, still Brampton?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"customer_request","summary":"Customer wants to order a plastic under-bumper shield or deflector for a 2025 Meridian Oriel, damaged by a snow bank. They asked about price, delivery time to Brampton and installation. A colleague's earlier message wrongly gave a delivery time and fitting time. I corrected that. Customer was not verified and no records were checked. A parts advisor needs to identify the part and confirm availability, price and fitting.","policy_rules_cited":["P08","P13","P11","P03"]}
